# Support

Gemini Notebook Prompt Lab is a community-maintained open-source project.

## If something is broken

Use the **Bug report** issue form and include reproducible steps, browser/device details, and screenshots when useful.

## If the product is confusing or could be better

Use the **User feedback / UX suggestion** issue form. Real usage context is more helpful than a generic feature wish.

## If you want to propose a prompt/theme

Use the **Prompt proposal** form and preserve source-grounding / provenance requirements.

## Security or private information

Do not put sensitive source material, private personal data, API keys, or security vulnerability details into a public issue. See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).
